judgment.rationale: Both are Performance Objectives in the same PRIMARY TWO Grade, Theme (Every Day Statistics), Sub-Theme (Data Collection and Presentation), and Topic (Data Collection), sharing rank 1. First objective collects data and arranges it in groups (boys/girls); second collects data and arranges it in arrays. They share the core 'collect data' skill (shared LC 0dd36465) and represent complementary data-arrangement methods rather than a clear dependency: neither arranging-in-arrays nor arranging-in-groups demonstrably supports success in the other, and same-rank sibling objectives lack substantive evidence for a developmental direction. This is meaningful conceptual coherence and reinforcement, warranting relatesTo (symmetric, no direction).
